title: Investigate successful Git reads with stderr in the existing review-identity runner
outcome: Determine whether ReviewIdentityGit can admit a partial successful Git read with stderr, and record a concrete reproduction or a justified refusal policy in its existing owner.
acceptance: Trace the existing ReviewIdentityGit success path and use a bounded discriminating diagnostic to establish whether an exit-zero partial read with stderr can affect identity; document the outcome and any necessary follow-up without adding a second reader.
